title: Pure Data Patch
description: Enhanced JSON schema representing a Pure Data (Pd) patch structure with full compatibility for Pd-vanilla

font_size.description: Font size used in the canvas

graph_on_parent.description: Whether the canvas is a graph displayed on its parent canvas

hide_name_and_args.description: Whether to hide the name and arguments of the canvas

objects.description: Collection of objects in the patch

size.description: Size of the object if customizable

gui_properties.description: Optional GUI properties for the object

font_size.description: Font size for the object's text

label_position.description: Position of the label relative to the object

external.description: Whether this object is an external (not part of Pd-vanilla)

libs_required.description: External libraries required by this object (if it's an external)

lists.description: Message-based sequencing lists associated with this object

delay.description: Delay time in milliseconds before sending the message

repeat_interval.description: Interval time in milliseconds between repeated messages

object_properties.description: Additional properties specific to this object type

hot.description: Whether this is a hot inlet (triggers computation)

connections.description: Connections between objects in the patch

color.description: RGB color for the connection line

gui_elements.description: GUI elements in the patch (sliders, toggles, number boxes, etc.)

id.description: Unique identifier for the GUI element

min.description: Minimum value of the GUI element

max.description: Maximum value of the GUI element

log_scale.description: Whether the slider uses logarithmic scaling

init.description: Whether to initialize with the saved value

current_value.description: Current value of the GUI element

label.description: Display label for the GUI element

label_position.description: Position of the label relative to the GUI element

send_symbol.description: Symbol name to send values to

receive_symbol.description: Symbol name to receive values from

visible.description: Whether the GUI element is visible

steady.description: For sliders, whether to jump to mouse position (false) or move steadily (true)

hold_time.description: For bangs, how long to hold the flash (in ms)

interrupt_time.description: For bangs, minimum interruption time between flashes (in ms)

widget_behavior.description: Widget behavior specific to this GUI element type

data_structures.description: Data structures, lists, arrays, and tables in the patch

id.description: Unique identifier for the data structure

size.description: Size of the array or table

template.description: Template structure for scalars and templates

size.description: Size of the field if it's an array

remote_control.description: Remote control configuration for the patch

multicast.description: Whether to use multicast for UDP

osc_path.description: Base OSC path for this patch

expose.description: Object IDs to expose for remote control

id.description: ID of the object to expose

path.description: Path to access the object remotely

channels.description: MIDI channels to listen on (empty means all)

save_path.description: Path where the patch is saved

search_paths.description: Additional search paths for abstractions and files

audio_files.description: Audio files referenced by the patch

data_files.description: Data files referenced by the patch

abstractions.description: Abstraction patches used in this patch

autoload_externals.description: Whether to automatically load missing external dependencies

load_on_startup.description: Whether to load all externals during patch initialization

skip_loaded.description: Whether to skip externals that are already loaded in the environment

error_handling.description: How to handle errors when loading externals

substitute_objects.description: Substitution objects to use if an external cannot be loaded

missing_object.description: Name of the external that might be missing

substitute_object.description: Object to use as a replacement

mcp_commands.description: Dynamic commands for real-time modifications via MCP

timestamp.description: Optional timestamp for scheduling events (in milliseconds)

scheduling.description: Timing and scheduling information for the patch

owner.description: ID of the object that owns this clock

scheduled_time.description: Scheduled logical time for the clock to trigger

id.description: Unique identifier for the delay element

delay_time.description: Delay time in milliseconds or samples

tap_tempo.description: Whether this delay supports tap tempo

active.description: Whether the metro is currently active

values.description: Stored parameter values by object ID

additionalProperties.description: Parameter values for a specific object

midi_mappings.description: Mappings of MIDI controls to patch parameters

event_type.description: Type of MIDI event to map

target_object.description: ID of the object to control

custom_curve.description: Array of points defining a custom response curve

enabled.description: Whether this mapping is currently active

device_name.description: Name of the MIDI device for this mapping (optional)

data.description: Action-specific data needed for undo operation
Action-specific data needed for redo operation

clean_state.description: Index in the undo stack representing the last saved state

max_undo_depth.description: Maximum number of undo steps to keep

groups.description: Logical groupings of objects for organizational purposes

name.description: Name of the group (e.g., 'Synth Voice 1', 'Effects Chain')

description.description: Optional description of the group's function

objects.description: IDs of objects included in this group

color.description: Optional RGB color for visual identification of the group

collapsed.description: Whether the group is initially collapsed in UI representations

parent_patch.description: Information about the parent patch, if this is a subpatch or abstraction

path.description: Path to the parent patch file

is_abstraction.description: Whether this patch is used as an abstraction in the parent

is_subpatch.description: Whether this patch is a subpatch in the parent

children.description: Child patches (subpatches and abstractions used in this patch)

id.description: Unique identifier for the child patch

path.description: Path to the child patch file (for abstractions) or empty for subpatches

object_id.description: ID of the corresponding object in the objects array

project_root.description: Path to the root directory of the project

dependencies.description: Dependencies on other patches not directly included

preset_morphing.description: Configuration for smooth transitions between presets

default_interpolation_time.description: Default time in milliseconds for morphing between presets

morphs.description: Predefined morph transitions between specific presets

interpolation_time.description: Time in milliseconds for this specific morph

custom_curve.description: Points defining a custom interpolation curve (normalized 0-1)

parameters.description: Specific parameters to include in this morph (empty means all)

current_morph.description: Information about any currently active morph

active.description: Whether a morph is currently in progress

end_time.description: Expected timestamp when the morph will complete

live_code.description: Configuration for live coding and expression evaluation

enabled.description: Whether live coding features are enabled

scripts.description: Stored scripts that can be executed

description.description: Description of what the script does

key_binding.description: Optional keyboard shortcut to execute this script

auto_execute.description: Whether to execute this script automatically on patch load

expression.description: Mathematical or logical expression to evaluate

result_target.description: Where to send the expression result

parameter.description: Parameter to set on the target object

trigger_source.description: Object that triggers this expression's evaluation

engine_type.description: Type of execution engine to use

external_engine_path.description: Path to external script execution engine (if used)

sandbox.description: Whether to run code in a sandboxed environment
